# solutions commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `components` | List components in a solution |
| `export` | Export a solution to a ZIP file |
| `get` | Get details for a specific solution |
| `import` | Import a solution from a ZIP file |
| `list` | List solutions in the environment |
| `publish` | Publish all customizations (alias for ppds publish --all) |
| `url` | Get the Maker portal URL for a solution |
